name: g29_empty_hands
purpose: Sneasler (Unburden, a Sitrus Berry) switches items with a Pokemon that holds nothing: the berry goes to the target (silent -enditem for the user, -item for the target) and Unburden doubles the user's Speed from the next turn; a Grimmsnarl without an item (Prankster) tricks a Staraptor and takes its Sharp Beak, whose holder is left with nothing.
